methodology: llama-bench on one M4 Max MacBook Pro, 128 GB unified memory (u/pmttyji). llama.cpp b8353 (commit 28955214d, 2026-03-04), Metal, macOS. Command: llama-bench -m <gguf> -fa 1 -d 0,8192 -p 512 -n 128 -ngl 99 -t 12. ONE request: pp512 is prefill of a 512-token prompt and tg128 is decode of 128 generated tokens, both batch 1. notes: Per-request. Same machine and build as the other seven cells in this post; only model and KV depth change. Q4_K_M is the filename quant; mapped to gguf-q4-k-m.
